title: Read CBOR records across incoming chunks
goal: Decode a finite CBOR measurement array while retaining only incomplete token bytes between incoming chunks.

title: Choose colour policy for redirected console output
goal: Request ANSI colour for a piped Unix console application, or disable it without changing persistent environment settings.

title: Express and check unsafe memory boundaries (experimental)
goal: Use experimental unsafe member contracts when a raw memory operation imposes caller obligations; review declaration accessibility and keep checked wrappers available.

title: Match every permitted state in an inheritance family
goal: Use a closed C# hierarchy when one assembly owns the direct states and consumers should match every permitted case. Seal leaves to bound further inheritance.

title: Model distinct outcomes with a C# union
goal: Use a C# 15 union when an operation returns one of several unrelated payload types and callers must handle every case, including unassigned storage.

title: Construct collections with deliberate capacity and comparison
goal: Use collection-expression arguments when constructor or builder configuration must accompany the elements. Preserve capacity, ordering and comparison semantics.

title: Stop or continue an enclosing loop directly
goal: Use labeled break and continue in C# 15 when a nested traversal must stop an enclosing loop or skip its remaining work while preserving cleanup.

title: Add computed properties to types you cannot edit
goal: Use a C# extension property for a cheap computed observation of an existing type. Retain method syntax for older targets or operations that behave like actions.

title: Add indexed access without editing a collection type
goal: Use extension indexers when a type you cannot edit needs bracket reads or writes. Define bounds, null handling and traversal cost explicitly.

title: Share helpers on an interface without adding implementation requirements
goal: Use non-virtual static interface helpers when a contract owns shared implementation code and callers need one fixed implementation without adding duties for implementing types.

title: Normalize and validate properties with the C# field keyword
goal: Use C# 14's field keyword to normalize or validate values in a property setter without declaring a separate backing field. Apply when property assignments need trimming, case conversion or input checks, while preserving constructor validation and the behavior of an explicit-field implementation.

title: Adapt existing types to generic operations (preview)
goal: Use preview SRTP resolution to adapt an existing type to a generic F# operation.

title: Bound asynchronous work before it starts
goal: Bound async workflows or task starts while retaining batch results in input order.

title: Compose record fields without repeating declarations and copies
goal: Use record spreads when a new named or anonymous F# record reuses existing fields and needs explicit additions or replacements.

title: Construct record values with positional or named arguments (preview)
goal: Use preview record constructor syntax when an F# record call benefits from positional arguments or reordered named arguments; retain record expressions when preview is unsuitable.

title: Render record and union diagnostics without reflection formatting
goal: Use generated record and union ToString implementations with --reflectionfree when diagnostics need field values in a trimming-conscious F# application.

title: Migrate unsupported enum flag operations
goal: Replace rejected non-integer enum bit operations with integer-backed permissions.

title: Pass compatible methods directly to delegates
goal: Pass a compatible F# method to a .NET delegate; retain adapters when arguments need transformation.

title: Keep an explicit display culture in F# diagnostic messages
goal: Format dates and numbers with an explicit culture before interpolating them when diagnostic messages must retain a chosen region across F# 10 and F# 11.

title: Require meaningful argument names at F# calls (preview)
goal: Require names on selected F# preview calls to prevent same-typed argument swaps.

title: Preserve failure stacks in computations (preview)
goal: Preserve an original failure stack inside F# async or task handlers with preview reraise.

title: Reuse inherited and external API documentation
goal: Reuse shared F# API summaries through inherited or external XML documentation.

title: Start an asynchronous computation on the caller
goal: Start a blocking async prefix on the caller, outside a SynchronizationContext.

title: Pass existing buffers to stream consumers
goal: Adapt borrowed memory, segmented bytes or encoded text to a Stream reader without first flattening the whole input.

title: Bind JSON to constructors with reference parameters
goal: Deserialize models with in/ref/ref readonly constructors and distinguish out outputs from writable-property assignment.

title: Resolve generic JSON converters and derived contracts
goal: Resolve reusable generic JSON contracts without per-closure registration or converter factories; reject incompatible shapes.

title: Define JSON naming and omission rules at the type boundary
goal: Apply type and member naming/ignore conventions with explicit precedence and stable wire contracts.

title: Export JSON schema for binary buffer values
goal: Export byte-array and memory-buffer schema annotations without a redundant base64 transform.

title: Generate JSON contracts for deliberately included private state
goal: Generate serialization metadata for intentionally included private members and constructors without exposing public model state.

title: Infer JSON contracts for a closed state family
goal: Infer JSON derived contracts for an owned closed hierarchy when type-driven discriminators suit the data contract. Check source-generation settings and retain explicit registrations for stable wire names.

title: Preserve initialized values when generated JSON omits a member
goal: Keep init-property defaults during generated deserialization while distinguishing omission from explicit values or null.

title: Reject malformed JSON at an import boundary
goal: Reject structurally malformed imported JSON before applying separate business validation.

title: Retrieve typed JSON metadata and distinguish resolution misses
goal: Retrieve typed serializer metadata and distinguish an unregistered contract from resolver or configuration failures.

title: Reuse a flushed JSON writer with different options
goal: Reuse a completed JSON writer across output targets and options while preserving stream ownership.

title: Preserve a union's distinct cases through JSON
goal: Persist and restore C# union outcomes with generated metadata and deliberate case selection. Apply structural classification when required root property names distinguish object payloads.

title: Round-trip F# union values with built-in JSON support
goal: Use built-in reflection-based System.Text.Json serialization when F# union cases and payload values must round-trip in an untrimmed JIT application.

title: Stream JSON records without collecting the input
goal: Write and read independent JSON Lines records while an asynchronous producer is still running.

title: Serialize numeric values and read-only collection contracts
goal: Use supported numeric, read-only-set and extension-data contracts on the .NET 11 target asset; preserve numeric representation choices.

title: Capture command output and cancel its execution
goal: Run a command that produces both output and diagnostics, and terminate it when the caller cancels.

title: Choose child lifetime independently of process bookkeeping
goal: Choose whether a worker survives its launcher, detaches from its console or is terminated when its parent exits.

title: Own process and redirected handles explicitly
goal: Start and wait for a native child while retaining clear ownership of its process and standard handles.

title: Distinguish normal exit from signal termination
goal: Report a native worker’s exit status without treating a POSIX signal as an ordinary application exit code.

title: Prepare a suspended child before allowing execution
goal: Perform post-creation setup before a worker executes, and terminate it if setup fails.

title: Match mixed newline conventions deliberately
goal: Apply regex anchors and dot to CRLF, CR, LF and Unicode line separators with an explicit newline policy.

title: Choose a character comparison policy explicitly
goal: Compare single UTF-16 characters or Unicode scalars using an explicit ordinal or culture-sensitive policy.

title: Encode binary data directly into Base64 buffers
goal: Round-trip binary payloads as standard padded Base64 characters or UTF-8 while retaining buffer and final-block contracts.

title: Transform text without splitting Unicode scalars
goal: Search or replace supplementary characters and retain explicit UTF-16 positions and replacement information.

title: Report the first malformed Unicode subsequence
goal: Locate invalid UTF-8 or UTF-16 input with offsets in the original encoding before decoding or transforming it.

title: Transfer accumulated text and empty its builder
goal: Hand accumulated text to a new StringBuilder while reusing an emptied source for the next batch.
